title: task_blocked — the coder or a rework tier blocks (#17)
description: Submitted only to block (docs/unmet-criteria C2): a stage that implements its task submits nothing. task_block_gate routes kind criterion to return_to_triage and kind scope to rescue_brief, and treats a criterion block with an empty criterion as scope, a gate check. _io is stamped by the server.

kind.description: criterion: an acceptance criterion cannot be met as written. scope: the task cannot be done without files outside it.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion, quoted. Required non-empty for kind criterion; empty for scope.

non_goal.description: The non-goal or constraint the criterion conflicts with, quoted, or empty.

reason.description: One or two sentences: why it cannot be done as written.
